name: Sana Malik
comment: Absolutely stunning quality! The embroidery on my kurta is so delicate — you can tell real care goes into each piece. Delivery was prompt and the packaging was beautiful. Already planning my next order!

name: Ayesha Siddiqui
comment: I ordered the navy embroidered kurta for Eid and received so many compliments. The handwork around the neckline is gorgeous and the colours are exactly as shown. Solace by Fia has become my go-to for special occasions.

name: Rabia Noor
comment: Beautiful pieces, very true to the photos. I took the unstitched kurta fabric to my tailor and it stitched up beautifully — soft and cool in the summer heat. A very happy purchase.

name: Fatima Zahra
comment: The hand-embroidered chaddar I received is absolutely gorgeous. Three months in and it still looks brand new. Worth every rupee — you can feel the quality the moment you hold it.

name: Maryam Hussain
comment: Ordered the ready-to-wear kurta and it fit perfectly. The embroidery at the neckline is so refined. Wore it to a daawat and everyone was asking where it was from. Love this brand!

name: Zainab Ali
comment: Great quality and lovely designs. The owner was very responsive and helpful throughout. My chaddar arrived beautifully pressed and packed. Would recommend to anyone who appreciates handcrafted clothing.
